artifacts.summary: Re-verified the uncommitted cslib H4 contract mirror and its union-valued index entry, confirmed the full verification bar (cslib PASS, union survives the upsert, no new budget violation), and claimed both paths for the postflight commit.

completion_data.completion_summary: Re-confirmed the cslib mirror copy of the H4 adversarial-verification contract (agent-system/extensions/cslib/context/contracts/adversarial-verification.md, 117 lines) and its union-valued index entry in agent-system/extensions/cslib/index-entries.json are present, structurally consistent, and pass check-extension-docs.sh's Rule R gate (cslib PASS); proved via a headless-Neovim merge simulation that the union of general-research-hard-agent and cslib-research-hard-agent survives the core-then-cslib upsert-by-path merge, and confirmed no new context-budget violation was introduced.

memory_candidates.content: When check-extension-docs.sh reports overall FAIL alongside a specific extension's PASS row, check whether the FAIL is a pre-existing, unrelated 'deployed script content drift' finding caused by another in-flight task's uncommitted edit before treating it as caused by the current change. Compare git status/log on the flagged file to distinguish. This distinction matters because a plan's verification criterion may name 'overall exit status' when only the extension-scoped row is actually in the task's file scope.

To prove (not assume) that neotex.plugins.ai.shared.extensions.merge.append_index_entries preserves a union-valued load_when.agents entry across an upsert-by-path collision between two extensions sharing the same context path, run a scratch headless-Neovim Lua script: require the merge module, call append_index_entries twice against a throwaway index file (core's entry first, the colliding extension's entry second, matching realistic processing order), then vim.json.decode the result and assert exactly one surviving entry with all expected agent names. Delete the scratch script and index file afterward.
